title: Understanding Aesthetics with Language: A Photo Critique Dataset for Aesthetic Assessment

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the general demographic statistics (age, gender, and geographical location) of the Reddit user base to identify cultural limitations and skew in the dataset's representation of aesthetic judgments.
Comparing the distributions of sentiment scores and annotated aesthetic scores across multiple datasets (AVA, PCCD, RPCD) to identify skewness and positivity bias in human ratings.
